title: ngano catalogue
description: The ngano catalogue is a JSON array of dataset records. Each record describes one published African-language speech (or speech-adjacent) dataset as its publisher describes it. Figures are copied from the source, never estimated.

isoCode.description: ISO 639-1, 639-2 or 639-3 language code as published by the source.

iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Must resolve against data/countries.json.

id.description: Stable slug, unique across the catalogue. Lowercase alphanumerics separated by single hyphens.

name.description: Dataset title as the publisher writes it.

task.description: What the dataset is usable for as released.

languages.description: Language names exactly as the source lists them. Empty only for aggregator records that name no language of their own.

languages_clean.description: Language names normalised to ngano's language index. This is a filtered view: entries the index does not cover, such as generic 'Multiple' labels, are dropped rather than guessed at, so it can be shorter than 'languages' or empty.

iso.description: Language codes for the languages above, where the source states them.

countries.description: Countries the speech comes from. Each entry must match a name in data/countries.json, or the literal 'Pan-African' for continent-wide collections.

country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for 'countries', in the same order, with 'Pan-African' omitted because it has no code.

regions.description: Regions derived from 'countries'. Never authored by hand, and empty for records whose only country entry is 'Pan-African'.

hours.description: Size as published, verbatim, including any qualifier the source attaches. null when the source states no size.

hours_num.description: Numeric hours parsed from 'hours'. null when the source states no size. Never estimated.

speakers.description: Speaker count or description as published. null when unstated.

recording_type.description: How the audio was captured, in the source's words, e.g. read, spontaneous, telephone, broadcast.

labelled.description: Whether transcripts ship with the audio.

domain.description: Subject domain, e.g. 'Read speech', 'Broadcast news', 'Call centre / telephony'.

licence.description: Licence string as published. 'Unstated' when the source gives none.

commercial.description: Whether commercial use is permitted, according to the licence.

access.description: How a user obtains the data.

host.description: Where the data lives, e.g. HuggingFace, OpenSLR, SADiLaR, LDC.

url.description: Primary source URL. null only where no stable public landing page exists, which the notes must then explain.

hf_repo.description: Hugging Face repo id, 'owner/name'. null when the dataset is not on the Hub.

year.description: Publication or last-release year as a four-digit string. null when the source states none.

notes.description: Free text: caveats, what the figures mean, why a field is null.

unverified_size.description: True when the size is self-reported at 20,000 hours or more and no independent confirmation exists. Records flagged true are excluded from every hours total.

language_tags.description: BCP 47 tags for this record's languages, in source order. The primary subtag is always an ISO 639-3 code; a region subtag marks a country-specific variety such as eng-NG.

language_codes.description: The bare ISO 639-3 codes from language_tags, deduplicated and order preserved.

language_note.description: Present only when the source describes its coverage in prose rather than naming individual languages, so the record carries no tags.
